The '''Kalinda system''', also known as the '''Kalindan system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the orange [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Kalinda]]. Six [[Planet/Legends|planets]] orbited Kalinda, protected by a dispersed [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] at the edge of the system. The sole habitable planet was [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]]. The system was discovered by and named for [[Jak Kalinda]].

==History==
The Kalinda system was strategically located between the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] space and a small segment of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] boundary. Sometime after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], an Imperial fleet that attempted to gain control of the system was repulsed by the [[Kalindan System Defense Force]], [[Kalindan Deep Space Fleet]], and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] secretly hired by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in an operation named [[Project Second Chance]].
